question: Related Questions Q. Assalamualaikum dear mufti sahab, my question is regarding interpretation of a dream i saw last night. I saw that i was with a girl (asma) whom i had tried to marry as i loved her but it didnt happen due to various circumstances & i got married to another girl (arshiya), Asma is still unmarried. I saw that she was with me as my wife & with my current wife (arshiya) & my mom cooking rotis in the kitchen. I was asking her to go & sleep as she has to go to work the next day. there were other things as well which i dont remember properly such seeing her use a table spoon to hit my mom on her head jokingly & then my mom said that she already has a wound on her head. there were other things as well which i dont remember. request you to please provide me tabeer of this dream. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 338 Country: United Kingdom Title: I have recently started to pactice my religion more serioulsy and since then I keep seeing dreams in which I take my hijaab off. Does this have any meaning? Question: I have recently started to pactice my religion more serioulsy and since then I keep seeing dreams in which I take my hijaab off. Does this have any meaning? Answer ID: 338 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 644=431/H) This is not a dream but it is whispering from Satan. You should ward it off by Lahaul and Istighfar i.e. لا حول و لا قوة الا باللہ العلي العظیم ۔ استغفر اللہ ربي من کل ذنب و اتوب الیہ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
